Get Vantor Basemap Seamlines as an sf Object (OGC WFS)

Source: R/vantor_seamlines_usage.R
vantor_get_seamlines.Rd

Queries the Vantor / Maxar Basemap Seamlines OGC Web Feature Service (WFS) to retrieve vector polygons representing the individual satellite imagery strips that make up a Vivid Mosaic basemap within an area of interest.

Usage

vantor_get_seamlines(
  bbox,
  product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",
  cql_filter = NULL,
  token = NULL,
  api_key = NULL,
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE)
)

Arguments

bbox

A spatial object (sf, sfc, bbox, SpatRaster, SpatVector, SpatExtent, stars, stars_proxy) or a numeric vector of length 4: c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax).

product

Character string. Vivid mosaic product name. Default is "VIVID_STANDARD_30". Options include "VIVID_STANDARD_30" and "VIVID_ADVANCED_15".

cql_filter

Character string. Optional custom CQL filter. If NULL, constructed automatically from product and bbox.

token

Character string. Optional OAuth2 bearer token.

api_key

Character string. Optional Maxar/Vantor API key.

verbose

Logical. Print progress messages. Default is getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

Value

An sf object (in EPSG:4326) containing the seamline polygons and their acquisition metadata, or NULL invisibly if the API request fails.

Details

Each returned polygon feature typically includes metadata attributes such as:

  • acq_time, acq_time_earliest, acq_time_latest: Imagery acquisition timestamp(s)

  • gsd: Ground sample distance (resolution)

  • sensor / vehicle_name: Satellite sensor identifier (e.g., "WV03", "WV02")

  • ona: Off-nadir angle

  • catid: Archive catalog ID of the source strip

Examples

# \donttest{
if (vantor_has_auth()) {
  aoi <- sf::st_bbox(
    c(xmin = -105.01, ymin = 39.73, xmax = -104.99, ymax = 39.75),
    crs = sf::st_crs(4326)
  )
  seamlines <- vantor_get_seamlines(aoi, verbose = FALSE)
}
# }
